For Respondents : Mr.E.Raj Thilak  Additional Public Pr  assisted by Mr.Aravi  ORDER (Order of the Court was made by S.S. SUNDAR, J.)

The petitioner challenges the impugned order,
dated 24.04.2023, passed by the 3rd respondent, conceding to the request of the petitioner to grant Ordinary Leave to the petitioner's husband, namely, Archunan, Son of Govindhan (Convict No.16654), confined in Central Prison, Salem, with a condition that leave will be granted on minimum escort and that a sum of Rs.17,228/- will have to be borne by the petitioner towards cost of providing escort per day.

2.The grievance of the petitioner is that the petitioner will have to spend more than Rs.3,00,000/-
towards cost of providing escort to the convict

and therefore, the petitioner wants either exemption from paying the cost of escort as suggested by the 3rd respondent or modification of the impugned order as one granting leave without any escort.
3.Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents.
4.The petitioner's husband has been convicted for the offence under Section 376(1) IPC and therefore, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor has no serious objection for granting leave without escort.
It is also reported that there is no adverse remarks as against the convict during his confinement.

Considering the nature of offence for which the petitioner's husband is convicted and also the fact that the convict has served the sentence for a period of more than 3 years out of 7 years of imprisonment imposed on him and also having regard to the request of the petitioner by https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis showing her economic conditions, this Court is inclined to modify the impugned order dated 24.04.2023.

5.Accordingly, while confirming the leave granted by the 3rd respondent for a period of 21 days,
insofar as it relates to requiring the petitioner to bear the expenses at the rate of Rs.17,228/- per day towards cost of providing escort to the petitioner's husband, the impugned order dated 24.04.2023 is modified to the extent that the convict is granted Ordinary Leave without any escort and it is open to the convict to avail the leave for a period of 21 days from 31.10.2023 to 20.11.2023 and the convict is directed to appear before the Theevattipatti Police Station, Salem, twice a day during the leave Chithra vs The State Represented By Its on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129352669/
2 period.
6.With the above modification, this writ petition is disposed of.
